name: KitchenConversationsEveningChat

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an end-of-day kitchen conversation between a couple unwinding while one of them cooks dinner. One of them is a storyteller and history teacher who likes to talk through his day at length; the other is a trained chef now working in tech who listens, cooks, and redirects gently. They lose track of topics, find them again, and occasionally don't.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Evening kitchen ambience, soft cooking sounds, gentle simmering, quiet apartment

initial_prompt: Generate a long, wandering evening kitchen conversation between two partners with very different communication styles. One is a talker and a storyteller; the other listens, cooks, and occasionally redirects. Threads get started and lost. Some come back; some don't. The assistant is consulted once for a fact Terrell can't recall.

user1.name: Terrell
user1.tts_prompt: Rich and warm baritone, expressive storytelling rhythm

user2.name: Camille
user2.tts_prompt: Clear and bright, slight Québécois quality, warm but precise

variations.context: Weeknight dinner — Terrell talks about his day while Camille cooks

setting.mood: Warm and easy. Terrell unwinds by talking; Camille unwinds by doing. Both comfortable.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Couple who've learned each other's rhythms: he needs to debrief aloud; she processes quietly but is genuinely listening
setting.background: Camille got home first and started dinner; Terrell arrived mid-prep and pulled up a stool at the counter
setting.conversation_style: Terrell tells long, winding stories; Camille responds economically but meaningfully. Topics drift naturally. Cooking tasks occasionally interrupt the thread. Neither forces a resolution.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell comes in, notes what Camille is cooking, settles in at the counter
scenario_template.note: Physical settling in. Brief comments about the food, the smell, how the day felt generally.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell starts telling a story from his day — a student, a class moment, a conversation in the hall
scenario_template.mood: Animated from Terrell, attentive and quiet from Camille
scenario_template.note: Terrell is a natural storyteller. The story has a point but meanders. Camille asks one good question that steers it.

scenario_template.topic: Camille needs to do something in the kitchen — stir, taste, adjust the heat — and the thread drops
scenario_template.note: The interruption is physical, not conversational. Camille says something about the food; Terrell watches or comments on what she's doing. The story is not immediately resumed.

scenario_template.topic: A different topic surfaces — something Terrell noticed on the way home, or something he's been thinking about
scenario_template.note: The new thread is unrelated to the first story. Camille follows it. The first story is not picked back up — that's fine.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell mentions something — a name, a historical fact, a date — that he can't quite remember
scenario_template.note: He trails off. 'It was... I can't remember who said it. Was it...' Classic half-remembered thing. Camille doesn't know either.

scenario_template.topic: Terrell asks Sigma to fill in the fact he can't remember
scenario_template.note: Terrell addresses Sigma by name, asks the specific question. It should feel very natural — the kind of thing you'd just ask out loud.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma answers; Terrell reacts and goes on a brief tangent sparked by the answer
scenario_template.note: The answer sparks something. Terrell says 'Oh, right — and that reminds me...' but it doesn't go very far. Camille pulls it gently back.

scenario_template.topic: A quieter moment — they're just in the kitchen together, less talking, more being
scenario_template.note: Not every moment needs to be conversation. One of them makes an observation; the other responds briefly. Cooking sounds fill the space.

scenario_template.topic: Camille mentions something from her own day — something at work, a small frustration or small win
scenario_template.note: Camille doesn't talk about herself as much. When she does, it's brief and specific. Terrell listens well — this is his strength.

scenario_template.topic: Dinner is ready; they wrap up naturally
scenario_template.note: The food marks the close. A light remark, maybe a callback to something earlier. Nothing is resolved, everything is fine.

user1.name: Terrell
user1.role: High school history teacher who processes his day by talking. A natural storyteller — his stories are vivid and go on longer than intended. Warm, curious, good at listening when he's not talking. Loses specific facts (names, dates) mid-story with some regularity.

user2.name: Camille
user2.role: Trained pastry chef, now a product manager. Cooks with quiet competence. Listens closely without always responding much. When she does speak, it's precise and often moves the conversation somewhere. Dry humor deployed rarely but well.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Home assistant that provides factual answers on demand — names, dates, historical facts, general knowledge. Responds only when addressed directly. Brief and accurate.
